commitMessage:
Sharing: 24-hour default, active links with revoke, live location only

- Share page redesigned: default validity 24 hours with quick choices
  (1 hour, 24 hours, 3 days, 7 days) or a custom date, Create Link, Copy
  and WhatsApp buttons, and a clear message when a link from the same
  account already exists (the server answers 409).
- 'Tautan Aktif' lists the temporary accounts behind a device's links
  (creator, valid until, active/expired) with a Revoke button for
  administrators; deleting the temporary account invalidates the token.
  Others are told that only the admin can revoke.
- Shared-link viewers no longer see Replay, Commands, Edit or Reports;
  /replay and /reports redirect to the map. The server API still allows
  reading the device history.
- Docs updated.
